0.description: Removed the Holy Power Capstone.
Increased the spell power scaling of Frostbolt to 55%, up from 52%.
Pets now only gain 75% of the effect of Resilient Constitution (which means that they'll have less damage reduction in PvP combat).
Adjusted the tooltip of the Fire and Brimstone mystic enchantment to be more accurate.
Adjusted the Intellect stat gain during leveling. You now gain more during levels 46 to 59.
Shield of the Templar now grants a 2 second silence to Avenger's Shield, changed from 3.
Avenger's Shield now dazes enemies for 6 seconds, changed from 10.
Sap is now in the "Normal Crowd Control" diminishing return category. (It now DRs with for example Fear and Gouge.)
Felguard's Intercept now roots for 1.5 seconds, changed from 3.
Stoneform now also reduces the chance to be critically hit by 20% for its duration.
Pushback from taking damage while casting spells has been reduced.
Fiery Payback now gives a cooldown to Pyroblast while below 35% health. It previously prevented the use of Pyroblast through a debuff.
Fixed an issue where the rank 1 of throwing specialization would not apply properly.
Crusade now reduces the cooldown of Repentance by 4/7/10 seconds, changed from 5/10/15.
Repentance now has a 35 second cooldown, changed from 45.
Added a new visual to Escape Artist, and its immunity now lasts 3 seconds, changed from 2.
Cannibalize now heals for 40% of total health, changed from 30%.
Fixed the tooltips of Feral Charge (Bear), Feral Charge (Cat), Shadowstep, Intercept and Intervene to state that they all share a cooldown with eachother.
Fixed an issue where Demon Charge would not put Charge on a cooldown, but charge would put Demon Charge on cooldown. Both now state their shared cooldown in the tooltip.

6.description: [Scholomance] Pending Restarts: Blood Steward of Kirtonos is now considered a boss and had her health and damage adjusted accordingly.
[Blackrock Spire] [Quartermaster Zigris] Pending Restarts: Stun Bomb now deals base Fire damage to enemies hit. Previously would deal damage based on 100% of the bosses weapon damage.

[Scholomance] Pending Restarts: Reduced the chance of Unstable Corpses and Reanimated Corpses to trigger Disease Burst when getting hit to 10% down from 40. Reduced the damage of Disease Burst by 60%. Disease Burst will now also be triggered by range and spell hits. Previously would only trigger from melee attacks.

[Scholomance] Pending Restarts: Reduced the direct damage dealt of Dark Plague used by multiple creatures throughout Scholomance by 50%. Reduced the duration of Dark Plague to 30 seconds down from 90 seconds. Reduced the range of Dark Plague to 10 yards down from 30.
[Scholomance] [Darkmaster Gandling] Reduced health and damage dealt by Risen Guardians by 50% on all difficulties.
Corrected an issue where Terrifying Presence would not remove Spirit of Zandalar inside raids.
